title: The Cascade of Stress: A Network Approach to Explore Differential Dynamics in Populations Varying in Risk for Psychosis
country: The Netherlands, Belgium, and The Netherlands (for studies)
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Medication status not available for all studies; - Group average estimates, not personalized networks; - No formal statistical tests for centrality comparisons; - Permutation testing used, but confidence intervals not provided.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability are not clearly declared in the main text, though supplementary materials may contain them. The authors used permutation testing for significance, but did not report confidence intervals for coefficients.
